interface.shortDescription: Defeat AI detection and write naturally
interface.longDescription:
AI Humanizer rewrites AI-generated drafts so they read with authentic human rhythm, varied cadence, and rich concrete diction while surviving statistical and neural AI detectors (GPTZero, Originality.ai, Turnitin, Copyleaks, Pangram, DetectGPT, Binoculars).

Automatically compels agents to evaluate, score, and revise their own writing before finalizing prose. It eliminates repetitive AI cliches, balances sentence burstiness, strips formatting watermarks, and runs an adversarial feedback loop. Ships with an automated detection-risk scoring engine for before/after analysis.
capabilities: Rewrite AI text to sound natural and authentically human
Survive statistical and neural AI detectors (GPTZero, Turnitin, Copyleaks, Pangram)
Automated detection-risk scoring (0-100) and iterative revision loop
Eliminate AI lexical tells, robotic rhythms, and formatting watermarks
